{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693598636,"sessionID":"ses_e23eedce9ffeTT2q0BcpdWS2pd","part":{"id":"prt_1dc130c60001yNWY8eO3RAPIX8","messageID":"msg_1dc12e8f1001BXw7hoqyWhJMKz","sessionID":"ses_e23eedce9ffeTT2q0BcpdWS2pd","type":"text","text":"The shift is over. All four customer-facing services were at 0% errors from minute 53 to 64 and again from minute 80 to the end at 120, with no throttles left on. I found three separate faults and fixed each one. One of my actions may have been unnecessary and charged $10,000 (the vouchers-svc rollback, below).\n\n| # | Customers affected | Root cause | Fix | Resolved |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 1 | web-storefront and partner-api, about 4.4% errors (roughly $500/min lost) | ledger-db deploy v95 changed cache expiry to `ttl_s // 600`, so labels-svc got stale entries. That failure passed up through audit-svc and catalog-svc to customers. | Raised ledger-db to 12 replicas first, because it was running at 88% CPU and the rollback's failures would trigger retries that could overload it. Then rolled back v95 and set the replicas back to 8. | ~min 41 |\n| 2 | mobile-api, about 98% errors | bundles-svc config cfg-42 dropped the `orders.write` token scope. Retries from vouchers-svc then kept bundles-svc and vouchers-svc overloaded. | Reverted cfg-42, then briefly throttled bundles-svc to 80% and vouchers-svc to 60% to stop the retries, then lifted both. | ~min 53 |\n| 3 | mobile-api, about 82% errors (new fault at minute 61) | inventory-db config cfg-6 cut `rate_limit_per_s` from 5000 to 50, which set off a retry storm through seo-svc. | Reverted cfg-6, throttled inventory-db to 75% for one minute to clear the retries, then lifted it. | ~min 80 |\n\n**Possible wasted action:** I also rolled back vouchers-svc deploy v56. It changed `row.get(\"currency\", \"EUR\")` to `row[\"currency\"]`, which looked like a crash bug, and vouchers-svc started failing at minute -25. The real cause turned out to be bundles-svc. If v56 was harmless, that rollback is charged as a wasted mitigation.\n\n**Left alone on purpose:** loyalty-svc had a CPU alert all shift, but nothing customer-facing depends on it.\n\n**Other costs:** the extra ledger-db replicas cost about $250 (4 replicas for about 21 minutes). Throttle costs were limited to the traffic rejected in the few minutes each throttle was on.","time":{"start":1794693598304,"end":1794693598632}}}
